accepted_repair_contributors.definition: Separately accepted first-persistence repair proof changed_targets[].contributing_observation_ids, with observation-level repair evidence; not the original batch membership.

candidate_matching.definition: Publication-timestamp search against eligible alert windows; match results are not evidence that the event occurred inside an alert.

classification_episode_id.definition: Proposed classifier-selected singular episode from proposed_matched_episode_id, stored on the native historical observation.

classification_evidence.definition: Structured candidate decision evidence payload, including a proposed classification episode; the live candidate object may store it. The historical batch instead stores selected component evidence.

episode_results[].source_observation_ids.definition: Frozen historical batch episode membership list built from the union of observation_episode_refs: proposed classification episode and candidate-matching singular/plural IDs.

frozen_source_memberships.definition: Episode membership materialized in original accepted H1 batch; the repair overlay can add separately accepted contributors. This is not a guarantee of unique native classifier binding.

matched_episode_id.definition: Singular matching result when publication-window search yields a unique representation; candidate queue can later overwrite it with an approved proposed classification episode.

matched_episode_ids.definition: Plural candidate set from publication-window temporal matching, not the final persisted membership list.

temporal_binding.definition: Classifier temporal-evidence structure; may carry event time and supported episode IDs, distinct from publication-time matching and final H1 source-membership union.

trigger_episode_ids.definition: Due-alert scheduler/queue discovery triggers recorded on candidate queue items, accumulated on rediscovery.
